Leaving the 200m obliged to alter course and shift out to obtain clear running. Rdr reported mount, which was racing on the synthetic surface for first time, failed to quicken on surface-added gelding may not have appreciated quick back up.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced four wide, without cover, in the early stages. Passing the 150m had to be checked after laying in and becoming awkwardly placed on heels. P/R vet no ab's.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat 3l off, ridden along turn, Straightened Up 2 Lengths off, found little and plodded home # weak run home
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Shifted out on jumping and bumped another runner. App rdr explained that, in his view, the gelding would be better suited over further distance. A post-race vet exam did not reveal any abnormalities. Trainer was advised that a warning would be placed on the geldings record with respect to its behaviour in the enclosure and behind the barriers.
